text:
sara-marketing: Quick sync  drafting launch posts + webinar invite + three landing pages (Hosted, Dedicated, Private). Need hero lines, 3 benchmark bullets, and inbound routing. Goal: v1 copy tomorrow morning.

linda-content: I6ll try 2 hero tones per page: developer-first and enterprise. Example Hosted dev: "Start serving models in minutes". Dedicated enterprise: "Committed capacity, predictable latency". Private: "Keep inference inside your network".

javier-growth: For social, keep headlines punchy: performance stat + CTA. Eg: "Serve at p99 < 250ms — see how in our webinar". Also need a short benchmark card for the landing: Latency | Throughput | Cost/1k.

emily-prod: I6ll drop numbers: p50/p95/p99, tok/s for batch sizes (1/8), and cost ballpark. Will add a note on fallback behavior for resource constraints.

mike-ux: I'll prototype a registration flow that sets hidden `product_mode` and `utm`. Two confirmation modal variants: standard and privacy-forward for Private.

rachel-sales: Routing rules: capture `product_mode` + `use_case`. If lead_score >= 70 and product_mode in (dedicated, private) -> AE queue; otherwise drip. Add checkbox: "Interested in Private deployment".

tom-ops: We can add webhook fields: `sf_campaign=launch_web_hot` and `page_variant`. Will add retry logic. Snippet: <input type="hidden" name="product_mode" value="hosted">

sara-marketing: Love it. Final ask: one-line footer about graceful degradation: "If capacity is constrained, requests may fall back to compatible model variants to preserve availability." Meeting to finalize: tomorrow 9:30 PT. Drop quick wire copy here before EOD.
